title: Precision study of 2D percolation critical exponents at L=512,1024,2048
note: FROZEN before any execution. Measures D_f, gamma/nu, beta/nu, tau, 1/nu at L in {512,1024,2048} with 2000 bootstrap draws each. Successor of Q-P005 (COMPLETE, ABNORMAL). Goal: determine if larger L resolves the tolerance misses (D_f off by 0.026, gamma/nu off by 0.032, beta/nu off by 0.025). Uses same p_c=0.59274605079210 and G_LAB rng(EXP-0004-certified). No cells from EXP-0009/EXP-0010 reused.

gates.C1: full-cell rerun (L=1024, p_c) cluster census bit-identical
gates.C6: seed ladder on M_max, chi at each L (n per seed from n_real)
gates.C7: pure-Python union-find independent: L in {512,1024}, subsample n=40, per-realization M_max and chi bit-identical
gates.FG: slope stability: refit D_f on inner sizes |d|<=0.02, gamma/nu |d|<=0.04
gates.PC1: bootstrap SE + chi2_red reported for every fit

decision_rule.H0_SUPPORTED: all gates PASS and all exponents in tolerance
decision_rule.ABNORMAL: gates PASS, some exponents out of tolerance
